sentences.en: Hi, may I speak to Mr. Kim, please?
sentences.ko: 안녕하세요, 김 선생님과 통화할 수 있을까요?

sentences.en: Sure, may I ask who's calling?
This is John from the marketing team.
I'm sorry, he's not available right now.
sentences.ko: 죄송하지만, 지금 그분이 자리에 안 계세요.

sentences.en: Please tell him to call me back later.
sentences.ko: 나중에 저에게 다시 전화해 달라고 전해주세요.

sentences.en: No problem, I'll pass along the message.
